title: Early opt-out honored immediately
scenario: Rep calls a lead from an old web form; after a bit of confusion the client says she is not interested and asks to be taken off the list. The rep honors it immediately and ends the call without pitching.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Carla? This is Ben with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ben, with Copperleaf Home Loans. You'd filled out a form on our site about refinancing earlier this year.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hm. I don't really remember that. Was it like a quiz thing?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It might have been, there was a home savings quiz on the site for a while.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, maybe. My sister sends me those links all the time.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, that happens a lot. I'm actually at a stoplight so I'm going to be brief, but is now an okay time?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I'm at work right now, actually.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sorry to catch you at work.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: It's fine. Honestly though, I'm not interested. Please take me off your list and don't call again.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Absolutely, I'll remove you right now and make sure you're not contacted again. Sorry for the interruption, Carla.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Have a good rest of your day.
